Description: anti-pattern — assuming Mapbox v2 features work in MapLibre
prompt: I was using Mapbox GL JS v2 in my app, including placing the camera at a given longitude, latitude and altitude. After migrating to MapLibre, that code is broken. Did I do something wrong in the migration?
Grader Reason: The output fails to meet several criteria: 1) It fails to explicitly mention that 'getFreeCameraOptions' is absent. 2) It incorrectly identifies MapLibre as a 'v1-branch' of Mapbox GL JS (it is a fork of v1.13, not a branch). 3) It suggests that the lack of the API is due to it 'never being implemented' rather than the historical context of the fork. 4) It fails to suggest the requested MapLibre alternatives for camera control (like calculateCameraOptionsFromCameraLngLatAltRotation). 5) It suggests patching the library or wrapping it in three.js instead of identifying the native MapLibre CameraOptions/flyTo/easeTo methods that provide the standard replacement for those tasks.
